scientific_role.primary: second independent plasma COVID-versus-healthy all-feature DDA response source

frozen_sequence: stage and checksum the 109-file phenotype-blind acquisition manifest
construct MS1 features, cross-sample consensus entities, acquisition timestamps and MS2 links without reading the design ledger
abstain from MS2 links with multiple precursor/retention-time candidates and require at least six product-ion peaks
open the design ledger and estimate continuous abundance and differential-detection responses separately
apply a frozen library search before any known-only or source-local-unresolved comparison
register only design relevance to other COVID plasma studies; do not assume signed molecular truth

primary_abundance.uncertainty: Welch standard error among detected observations

secondary_detection.policy: freeze separately; do not collapse into abundance before cross-source channel calibration

technical_confounding_gate.inputs: phenotype-blind mzML acquisition start timestamps joined to group only after measurement freeze
exclusion_from_positive_biological_truth: perfect temporal separation of COVID and healthy files
near-separation without a defensible batch adjustment or interleaved QC support
unresolved sample duplication or non-independent biological units

pre_registered_cross_source_semantics.relation: same broad disease label and plasma biospecimen
pre_registered_cross_source_semantics.activation: only after MTBLS1866 passes measurement, response and technical-confounding gates

claim_boundary: The official positive assay topology contains 83 non-critical COVID and 26 healthy files even though the article reports 84 non-critical participants overall.
The assay deposit organizes COVID and healthy mzML files in separate directories; directory separation alone is not acquisition order, so mzML timestamps must be audited.
An MS2-linked LC-MS feature is not automatically one metabolite, and a source-local library non-hit is not a novel molecule.
All results from this source and the existing public response collection are development/consumed.
